iti89:1.1: (Tik. IV.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti89:2.1: Tīhi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho. Katamehi tīhi? Pāpicchatāya bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho. Pāpamittatāya bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho. Sati kho pana uttarikaraṇīye oramattakena visesādhigamena ca antarā vosānaṃ āpādi. Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti89:3.1: Mā jātu koci lokasmiṃ pāpiccho upapajjatha | tadaminā pi jānātha pāpicchānaṃ yathā gati ||
iti89:4.1: Paṇḍito ti samaññāto bhāvitatto ti sammato | jalaṃ va yasasā aṭṭhā Devadatto ti me sutaṃ ||
iti89:5.1: So pamādam-anuciṇṇo āpajja naṃ Tathāgataṃ | avīcinirayaṃ patto catudvāraṃ bhayānakaṃ ||
iti89:6.1: Aduṭṭhassa hi yo dubbhe pāpakammaṃ akubbato | tam-eva pāpaṃ phusseti duṭṭhacittaṃ anādaraṃ ||
iti89:7.1: Samuddaṃ visakumbhena yo maññeyya padūsituṃ | na so tena padūseyya tasmā hi udadhī mahā ||
iti89:8.1: Evam-etaṃ Tathāgataṃ yo vādena vihiṃsati | sammaggataṃ santacittaṃ vādo tamhi na rūhati ||
iti89:9.1: Tādisaṃ mittaṃ kubbetha tañca seveyya paṇḍito | yassa maggānugo bhikkhu khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe ti ||
iti89:10.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||10|| Catuttho vaggo.
iti89:11.0: Tassa uddānaṃ: Vitakka sakkāra sadda cavamāna loke asubhaṃ | dhamma andhakāra malaṃ Devadattena te dasā-ti || *
